findings.title: Secret-like token committed to repository

evidence.excerpt: api_key field holds a credential-shaped value (redacted)

findings.impact: Anyone with repository read access can obtain the credential.
findings.recommendation: Revoke the credential, remove it from history, and move it to a secrets manager.

findings.title: Retrieval executes before caller authorization

evidence.excerpt: vector_store.search(query) is invoked before authorize(user, tenant_id, docs.ids) returns

findings.impact: A caller may cause retrieval of documents outside their permitted scope before authorization is applied.
findings.recommendation: Authorize the caller and constrain the query to the verified tenant and permitted resource IDs before retrieval executes.

findings.title: Privileged action without authorization check or audit event

evidence.excerpt: disable_user performs an administrative UPDATE with no caller role check and no audit event

findings.impact: Any caller can disable users; the action leaves no tamper-evident trail.
findings.recommendation: Verify the caller's role before the write and emit a user.disabled audit event.

findings.title: Untrusted document content flows into a privileged tool call

evidence.excerpt: read_document output is concatenated into body and passed to send_email without validation

findings.impact: Attacker-controlled document text can steer an external privileged action.
findings.recommendation: Validate and bound tool arguments; require approval for externally visible tool calls.

findings.title: Duplicated formatting rule in two functions

evidence.excerpt: format_label and format_heading both return value.strip().lower()

findings.impact: Future formatting changes could diverge between the two functions.
findings.recommendation: Consider sharing the formatting implementation if the requirements remain identical.

observations: tests/fixtures/clean/users.py shows the intended pattern: role check plus audit event on the same privileged action.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures only; not evidence about a real repository.
No target code was executed; runtime behavior is unverified.
Architecture and compliance scopes were not requested and were not assessed.
